id.title: Sapo by Mehuli · menu darurat konsol
id.menu:
1. Reset password admin
  2. Reset pengaturan jaringan
  3. Restart NAS
  4. Matikan NAS
  5. Sambungkan Wi-Fi
  6. Muat ulang layar
id.pressEnter: Tekan Enter untuk kembali ke menu.
id.noAdmin: Belum ada administrator (setup awal belum selesai). Buka panel untuk setup awal.
id.resetAdminHelp: Password admin yang dipilih diganti password sementara, 2FA dan kode cadangannya dihapus, dan akunnya diaktifkan kembali. Saat login, admin wajib mengganti password dan memasang 2FA lagi. Data dan pengguna lain tidak berubah.
id.resetAdminDone: Password %s sudah di-reset. Password sementara (catat, hanya tampil sekali):
id.resetAdminNext: Login ke panel dengan password ini, lalu ganti password dan pasang 2FA. Password Samba admin ini baru berganti setelah password panel diganti.
id.resetNetworkHelp: Semua antarmuka kabel kembali memakai DHCP (alamat dari router), Wi-Fi dimatikan (sambungkan lagi lewat menu 5), dan pengaturan akses panel (port, jaringan yang boleh, nama host) kembali ke bawaan. File lama disimpan sebagai cadangan:
id.resetNetworkDone: Jaringan dan akses panel sudah di-reset. Alamat IP baru tampil di menu setelah DHCP selesai.
id.confirmReboot: Restart NAS sekarang? Ketik y untuk ya:
id.confirmPoweroff: Matikan NAS sekarang? Ketik y untuk ya:
id.wifiNone: Tidak ada kartu Wi-Fi yang dikenali. Bila komputer punya Wi-Fi, firmware-nya mungkin belum didukung; pakai kabel LAN.
id.wifiPending: Ada perubahan jaringan dari panel yang belum dikonfirmasi. Tunggu sampai selesai atau dibatalkan, lalu coba lagi.
id.wifiConnected: Tersambung ke %s. Alamat NAS: %s. Buka panel dari komputer lain di jaringan yang sama.
id.wifiFailed: Tidak bisa tersambung ke %s (password salah atau sinyal terlalu lemah). Pengaturan jaringan lama dikembalikan.

en.title: Sapo by Mehuli · console recovery menu
en.menu:
1. Reset admin password
  2. Reset network settings
  3. Restart NAS
  4. Shut down NAS
  5. Connect to Wi-Fi
  6. Refresh screen
en.pressEnter: Press Enter to return to the menu.
en.noAdmin: There is no administrator yet (first-run setup isn’t done). Open the panel to run setup.
en.resetAdminHelp: The chosen admin’s password is replaced with a temporary one, its 2FA and backup codes are removed, and the account is re-enabled. On login the admin must change the password and set up 2FA again. Data and other users are unchanged.
en.typeUsername: Type the user name %s to continue:
en.resetAdminDone: The password of %s has been reset. Temporary password (write it down, shown only once):
en.resetAdminNext: Sign in to the panel with it, then change the password and set up 2FA. This admin’s Samba password only changes once the panel password is changed.
en.resetNetworkHelp: All wired interfaces go back to DHCP (address from the router), Wi-Fi is turned off (connect again with option 5), and panel access settings (port, allowed networks, host names) go back to defaults. The old files are kept as backups:
en.resetNetworkDone: Network and panel access have been reset. The new IP address appears in the menu once DHCP is done.
en.confirmReboot: Restart the NAS now? Type y for yes:
en.confirmPoweroff: Shut down the NAS now? Type y for yes:
en.wifiNone: No Wi-Fi card was recognized. If the computer has Wi-Fi, its firmware may not be supported yet; use a LAN cable.
en.wifiPending: A network change from the panel has not been confirmed yet. Wait until it finishes or is cancelled, then try again.
en.wifiHidden: Type a network name yourself (hidden network)
en.wifiPassword: Wi-Fi password for %s (not shown while typing):
en.wifiConnecting: Connecting to %s, wait up to 90 seconds…
en.wifiConnected: Connected to %s. NAS address: %s. Open the panel from another computer on the same network.
en.wifiFailed: Could not connect to %s (wrong password or signal too weak). The previous network settings were restored.
